```python
# 推斷：資料表=上期報價、本期報價（表頭第1列）｜欄位=品號、品名、單價、幣別、計價單位｜主檔=品號｜輸出=新增「增刪對照表」
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

ws_prev = wb["上期報價"]
ws_curr = wb["本期報價"]

# 讀取表頭（兩表欄位相同，以上期為基準）
base_headers = [cell.value for cell in ws_prev[1]]
new_headers = ["差異類型"] + base_headers

# 讀取資料列，以品號為鍵
prev_data = list(ws_prev.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True))
curr_data = list(ws_curr.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True))

prev_rows = {row[0]: row for row in prev_data}
curr_rows = {row[0]: row for row in curr_data}

prev_keys = [row[0] for row in prev_data]
curr_keys = [row[0] for row in curr_data]

# 建立「增刪對照表」
sheet_name = "增刪對照表"
if sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:
    del wb[sheet_name]
ws_new = wb.create_sheet(title=sheet_name)

# 寫入表頭
ws_new.append(new_headers)
for cell in ws_new[1]:
    cell.font = Font(bold=True)

# 新增：本期有、上期沒有
for key in curr_keys:
    if key not in prev_rows:
        ws_new.append(["新增"] + list(curr_rows[key]))

# 刪除：上期有、本期沒有
for key in prev_keys:
    if key not in curr_rows:
        ws_new.append(["刪除"] + list(prev_rows[key]))

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
import openpyxl

# 推斷：資料表=舊版BOM、新版BOM（表頭第1列）｜欄位=料號｜差異輸出=新工作表

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

old_ws = wb["舊版BOM"]
new_ws = wb["新版BOM"]

# 讀取舊版 BOM
old_header = [cell.value for cell in next(old_ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=1, max_col=old_ws.max_column))]
old_data = []
for row in old_ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_col=old_ws.max_column, values_only=True):
    old_data.append(row)

# 讀取新版 BOM
new_header = [cell.value for cell in next(new_ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=1, max_col=new_ws.max_column))]
new_data = []
for row in new_ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_col=new_ws.max_column, values_only=True):
    new_data.append(row)

# 建立 料號 -> 整列 對照，保留原始順序
old_key_col = old_header.index("料號")
new_key_col = new_header.index("料號")

old_dict = {row[old_key_col]: row for row in old_data}
new_dict = {row[new_key_col]: row for row in new_data}

old_keys = set(old_dict.keys())
new_keys = set(new_dict.keys())

added_keys = [row[new_key_col] for row in new_data if row[new_key_col] not in old_keys]
deleted_keys = [row[old_key_col] for row in old_data if row[old_key_col] not in new_keys]

# 建立新工作表
diff_ws = wb.create_sheet(title="BOM差異")

# 寫入表頭
output_header = ["差異類型"] + new_header
diff_ws.append(output_header)

# 先列新增（取自新版 BOM）
for key in added_keys:
    diff_ws.append(["新增"] + list(new_dict[key]))

# 再列刪除（取自舊版 BOM）
for key in deleted_keys:
    diff_ws.append(["刪除"] + list(old_dict[key]))

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

ws_curr = wb["本期報價"]

prev_header = [cell.value for cell in ws_prev[1]]
curr_header = [cell.value for cell in ws_curr[1]]

# 以品號為鍵建立對照（品號在第 1 欄）
prev_dict = {}
for row in ws_prev.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):

curr_dict = {}

        curr_dict[pn] = row

curr_set = set(curr_dict.keys())

added_pns = [pn for pn in curr_dict if pn not in prev_set]      # 本期有、上期無
deleted_pns = [pn for pn in prev_dict if pn not in curr_set]    # 上期有、本期無

# 建立新工作表
new_ws_name = "新增與刪除"
if new_ws_name in wb.sheetnames:
    # 若已存在則移除舊表，避免衝突
    del wb[new_ws_name]
new_ws = wb.create_sheet(title=new_ws_name)

# 寫入表頭：前面加「差異類型」
new_header = ["差異類型"] + prev_header
new_ws.append(new_header)

# 新增排前面，資料照原表帶（本期順序）
for pn in added_pns:
    new_ws.append(["新增"] + list(curr_dict[pn]))

# 再排刪除（上期順序）
for pn in deleted_pns:
    new_ws.append(["刪除"] + list(prev_dict[pn]))

# 設定新表頭粗體
for cell in new_ws[1]:
    cell.font = Font(bold=True)

# 儲存結果
wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH, data_only=True)

ws_prev = wb["上期報價"]
ws_curr = wb["本期報價"]

def read_sheet(ws):
    rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    header = list(rows[0])
    key_idx = header.index("品號")
    key_to_row = {}
    ordered_rows = []
    for row in rows[1:]:
        if row[key_idx] is None:
            continue
        key_to_row[row[key_idx]] = row
        ordered_rows.append(row)
    return header, key_idx, key_to_row, ordered_rows

prev_header, prev_key_idx, prev_map, prev_rows = read_sheet(ws_prev)
curr_header, curr_key_idx, curr_map, curr_rows = read_sheet(ws_curr)

# 新增：在本期有、上期沒有；刪除：在上期有、本期沒有
added_rows = [row for row in curr_rows if row[curr_key_idx] not in prev_map]
deleted_rows = [row for row in prev_rows if row[prev_key_idx] not in curr_map]

# 建立新工作表
ws_out = wb.create_sheet(title="差異比對")

for row in added_rows:

for row in deleted_rows:
    ws_out.append(["刪除"] + list(row))

# 儲存結果
wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
this_headers = [cell.value for cell in ws_this[1]]

last_dict = {}
for row in ws_last.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):

    if emp_id:
        last_dict[emp_id] = row

this_dict = {}
for row in ws_this.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):

        this_dict[emp_id] = row
```

```python
    rows = list(ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True))
```

```python
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

ws_last = wb["上月名冊"]
ws_this = wb["本月名冊"]

# 讀取表頭
last_header = [cell.value for cell in ws_last[1]]
this_header = [cell.value for cell in ws_this[1]]

# 以員工編號為鍵建立對照
last_rows = {}
for row in ws_last.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    emp_id = row[0]
    if emp_id:
        last_rows[emp_id] = row

this_rows = {}
for row in ws_this.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    emp_id = row[0]
    if emp_id:
        this_rows[emp_id] = row

last_ids = set(last_rows.keys())
this_ids = set(this_rows.keys())

added_ids = this_ids - last_ids
deleted_ids = last_ids - this_ids

# 建立新工作表「增刪對照表」，並放到最前面
ws_new = wb.create_sheet("增刪對照表", 0)

        ws_new.append(["新增"] + list(this_rows[emp_id]))

# 再寫入刪除資料（依上月名冊順序）
for emp_id in last_rows:
    if emp_id in deleted_ids:
        ws_new.append(["刪除"] + list(last_rows[emp_id]))

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
# 推斷：資料表=舊版BOM（表頭第1列）與新版BOM（表頭第1列）｜欄位=原表所有欄位｜主檔=新版BOM｜鍵=料號｜篩選=新增（在新版不在舊版）、刪除（在舊版不在新版）｜輸出=新工作表「BOM差異」
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)
ws_old = wb["舊版BOM"]
ws_new = wb["新版BOM"]

new_pns = {row[pn_idx] for row in new_rows}

deleted_rows = [row for row in old_rows if row[pn_idx] not in new_pns]
```

```python
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)
```

```python
ws_act = wb["實盤"]

# 建立表頭對照
def header_map(ws, row=1):
    return {
        str(ws.cell(row=row, column=c).value).strip(): c
        for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1)
        if ws.cell(row=row, column=c).value is not None
    }

sys_map = header_map(ws_sys)
act_map = header_map(ws_act)

for r in range(2, ws_act.max_row + 1):

    if v is not None:

only_in_system = []
```

```python
import openpyxl
```

```python
def get_col_map(ws, header_row=1):
    """建立「欄名 → 欄號」對照"""
    return {
        ws.cell(row=header_row, column=col).value: col
        for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1)
    }

def norm_pn(value):
    """品號正規化：去空白、轉小寫"""
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()

    for row in range(2, ws_current.max_row + 1):
        current_keys.add(norm_pn(ws_current.cell(row=row, column=cur_pn_col).value))

# 2. 讀取上期報價，抓出本期沒有的品號
ws_prev = wb["上期報價"]
```

```python
# 推斷：資料表=舊版BOM、新版BOM（表頭第1列）｜鍵=(料號, 料件屬性)｜比對欄位=數量｜輸出=新工作表「數量差異」

import openpyxl
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

INPUT_PATH = INPUT_PATH
OUTPUT_PATH = OUTPUT_PATH

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

# 讀取工作表並建立 鍵 -> 數量 對照
def read_bom(sheet_name):
    ws = wb[sheet_name]
    headers = [cell.value for cell in ws[1]]
    col_idx = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(headers)}

    key_qty = {}
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
        pn = str(row[col_idx["料號"]]).strip() if row[col_idx["料號"]] is not None else ""
        attr = str(row[col_idx["料件屬性"]]).strip() if row[col_idx["料件屬性"]] is not None else ""
        qty = row[col_idx["數量"]]
        try:
            qty = float(qty)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            qty = None
        key = (pn, attr)
        key_qty[key] = qty
    return key_qty

old_qty = read_bom("舊版BOM")
new_qty = read_bom("新版BOM")

# 找出數量不同的項目（以舊版BOM的順序輸出）
diff_rows = []
for key, old_q in old_qty.items():
    new_q = new_qty.get(key)
    if new_q is None:
        continue
    if old_q != new_q:
        diff_rows.append((key[0], key[1], old_q, new_q))

# 建立新工作表
ws_diff = wb.create_sheet(title="數量差異")
ws_diff.append(["料號", "料件屬性", "舊數量", "新數量"])

for row in diff_rows:
    ws_diff.append(row)

# 調整欄寬（可選，讓資料可視）
for col in range(1, 5):
    ws_diff.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(col)].width = 14

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
import openpyxl
```

```python
def read_price_map(ws):
    # 建立欄名→欄號對照
    header = {}
    for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
        val = ws.cell(row=1, column=col).value
        if val is not None:
            header[val] = col

    data = {}
    order = []
    for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
        pn = ws.cell(row=row, column=header['品號']).value
        ms = ws.cell(row=row, column=header['M/S']).value
        price = ws.cell(row=row, column=header['單價']).value
        key = (pn, ms)
        data[key] = price
        order.append(key)
    return data, order

new_data, _ = read_price_map(new_ws)

for key in old_order:

    old_price = old_data.get(key)
    new_price = new_data.get(key)

# 補上本期有、上期沒有的項目
for key, new_price in new_data.items():

# 建立新工作表
```

```python
import openpyxl
```

```python
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

ws_prev = wb["上期報價"]
ws_curr = wb["本期報價"]

# 建立欄名對照（表頭在第 1 列）
def header_map(ws):
    headers = {}
    for col_idx, cell in enumerate(ws[1], start=1):
        if cell.value:
            headers[str(cell.value).strip()] = col_idx
    return headers

map_prev = header_map(ws_prev)
map_curr = header_map(ws_curr)

# 必要欄位檢查
required = ["品號", "主替", "單價"]
for name, mp in [("上期報價", map_prev), ("本期報價", map_curr)]:
    for col in required:
        if col not in mp:
            raise ValueError(f"工作表「{name}」缺少必要欄位「{col}」")

# 讀取上期報價，以 (品號, 主替) 為鍵
prev_prices = {}
for row in ws_prev.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    key = (row[map_prev["品號"] - 1], row[map_prev["主替"] - 1])
    prev_prices[key] = row[map_prev["單價"] - 1]

# 比對本期報價，找出單價不同的項目
diff_rows = []
for row in ws_curr.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    key = (row[map_curr["品號"] - 1], row[map_curr["主替"] - 1])
    new_price = row[map_curr["單價"] - 1]
    old_price = prev_prices.get(key)
    if old_price is None:
        continue  # 上期沒有的項目不列入
    # 轉成數值比較
    try:
        old_val = float(old_price) if old_price is not None else None
        new_val = float(new_price) if new_price is not None else None
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        old_val = old_price
        new_val = new_price
    if old_val != new_val:
        diff_rows.append([key[0], key[1], old_price, new_price])

# 建立新工作表
output_sheet_name = "單價差異"
if output_sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:
    # 若已存在，先移除
    del wb[output_sheet_name]
ws_out = wb.create_sheet(title=output_sheet_name)

# 寫入表頭
ws_out.append(["品號", "主替", "舊單價", "新單價"])

# 寫入差異資料
for r in diff_rows:
    ws_out.append(r)

# 儲存結果
wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
import openpyxl

# 載入工作簿
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

# 讀取「系統帳」與「實盤」兩張表，建立 (料號, 料件屬性) -> 數量 對照
def build_qty_dict(sheet):
    rows = list(sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    header = rows[0]
    col_idx = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(header)}
    data = {}
    for row in rows[1:]:
        mat = row[col_idx["料號"]]
        prop = row[col_idx["料件屬性"]] or ""
        qty = row[col_idx["數量"]]
        data[(mat, prop)] = qty
    return data

sys_data = build_qty_dict(wb["系統帳"])
act_data = build_qty_dict(wb["實盤"])

# 找出兩表都有、且數量不同的項目
changes = []
for key in sorted(set(sys_data) & set(act_data)):
    old_qty = sys_data[key]
    new_qty = act_data[key]
    if old_qty != new_qty:
        changes.append((key[0], key[1], old_qty, new_qty))

# 建立新工作表「數量變動」
ws_new = wb.create_sheet(title="數量變動")
ws_new.append(["料號", "料件屬性", "舊數量", "新數量"])
for row in changes:
    ws_new.append(row)

# 儲存結果
wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
import openpyxl

# 讀取工作簿
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)
old_ws = wb['舊版BOM']
new_ws = wb['新版BOM']

def read_sheet(ws):
    """讀取表頭與資料列，回傳欄名→索引對照與資料列"""
    header = [cell.value for cell in ws[1]]
    col_map = {name: idx for idx, name in enumerate(header)}
    rows = list(ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True))

    new_qty[key] = row[new_map[qty_field]]

diff_rows = []
```

```python
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

def build_qty_map(ws):
    headers = {cell.value: idx for idx, cell in enumerate(ws[1], start=1)}
    col_pn = headers["料號"]
    col_mt = headers["主替"]
    col_qty = headers["數量"]
    qty_map = {}
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):

        mt = row[col_mt - 1] or ""
        qty = row[col_qty - 1]
        try:

    return qty_map

new_map = build_qty_map(wb["新版BOM"])
```

```python
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)
```

```python
# 建立欄名對照（表頭在第 1 列）
sys_headers = {cell.value: idx for idx, cell in enumerate(ws_sys[1], start=1)}
act_headers = {cell.value: idx for idx, cell in enumerate(ws_act[1], start=1)}

for sys_row in ws_sys.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):

    for col_idx, header in enumerate(ws_sys[1], start=1):

# 儲存結果
```

```python
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

ws_old = wb["上月名冊"]
ws_new = wb["本月名冊"]

def read_sheet(ws):
    rows = list(ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, values_only=True))
    header = rows[0]
    data = rows[1:]
    return header, data

header_old, data_old = read_sheet(ws_old)
header_new, data_new = read_sheet(ws_new)

col_old = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(header_old)}
col_new = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(header_new)}

key = "員工編號"
# 以員工編號建立本月名冊查詢表
new_by_id = {}
for row in data_new:
    emp_id = row[col_new[key]]
    if emp_id is not None:
        new_by_id[emp_id] = row

# 要比對的欄位（排除員工編號本身），保持原表頭順序
fields = [f for f in header_old if f != key]

changes = []
for row_old in data_old:
    emp_id = row_old[col_old[key]]
    if emp_id is None or emp_id not in new_by_id:
        continue
    row_new = new_by_id[emp_id]
    for field in fields:
        if field not in col_new:
            continue
        old_val = row_old[col_old[field]]
        new_val = row_new[col_new[field]]
        # 將 None 視為空字串比對
        old_cmp = "" if old_val is None else old_val
        new_cmp = "" if new_val is None else new_val
        if old_cmp != new_cmp:
            changes.append([emp_id, field, old_cmp, new_cmp])

# 新增「變更明細」工作表
ws_out = wb.create_sheet(title="變更明細")
ws_out.append(["員工編號", "變更欄位", "舊值", "新值"])
for change in changes:
    ws_out.append(change)

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
# 推斷：資料表=上期報價/本期報價（表頭第1列）｜鍵=品號｜比較欄位=品名、單價、幣別、計價單位｜輸出=新增工作表「變更明細」
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

ws_prev = wb["上期報價"]
ws_curr = wb["本期報價"]

# 讀取表頭
prev_header = [cell.value for cell in ws_prev[1]]
curr_header = [cell.value for cell in ws_curr[1]]

key_col = prev_header.index("品號")

# 建立本期資料字典：品號 -> 整列值
curr_dict = {}
for row in ws_curr.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    key = row[key_col]
    if key is not None:
        curr_dict[key] = row

# 新增工作表
ws_diff = wb.create_sheet(title="變更明細")
ws_diff.append(["品號", "變更欄位", "舊值", "新值"])

# 依上期報價原表列序比對
for row in ws_prev.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    key = row[key_col]
    if key is None or key not in curr_dict:
        continue
    curr_row = curr_dict[key]
    for col_idx, field_name in enumerate(prev_header):
        if col_idx == key_col:
            continue  # 鍵本身不列入變更
        old_val = row[col_idx]
        new_val = curr_row[col_idx]
        if old_val != new_val:
            ws_diff.append([key, field_name, old_val, new_val])

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font

# 讀取工作簿
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)
ws_sys = wb["系統帳"]
ws_phy = wb["實盤"]

# 讀取表頭
sys_headers = [cell.value for cell in ws_sys[1]]
phy_headers = [cell.value for cell in ws_phy[1]]

# 料號欄位索引
key_col = sys_headers.index("料號")

# 將「實盤」以料號為鍵建立對照
phy_map = {}
for row in ws_phy.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    key = row[key_col]
    phy_map[key] = row

# 要比對的欄位（除了料號，保留原表欄位順序）
compare_cols = [i for i, h in enumerate(sys_headers) if h != "料號"]

# 建立新工作表
result_name = "差異明細"
if result_name in wb.sheetnames:
    result_name = "差異明細_新"
ws_res = wb.create_sheet(title=result_name)
ws_res.append(["料號", "變更欄位", "舊值", "新值"])

# 依「系統帳」原列序比對
for sys_row in ws_sys.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    key = sys_row[key_col]
    phy_row = phy_map.get(key)
    if phy_row is None:
        continue
    for col_idx in compare_cols:
        old_val = sys_row[col_idx]
        new_val = phy_row[col_idx]
        if old_val != new_val:
            ws_res.append([
                key,
                sys_headers[col_idx],
                old_val,
                new_val
            ])

# 標題列設為粗體
for cell in ws_res[1]:
    cell.font = Font(bold=True)

# 儲存結果
wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
import openpyxl

# 載入工作簿
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)
old_ws = wb["舊版BOM"]
new_ws = wb["新版BOM"]

# 建立表頭對照（表頭在第 1 列）
def build_header_map(ws):
    return {ws.cell(row=1, column=col).value: col
            for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1)
            if ws.cell(row=1, column=col).value}

old_header = build_header_map(old_ws)
new_header = build_header_map(new_ws)

# 以「料號」建立新版索引
new_key_col = new_header["料號"]
new_rows_by_key = {}
for row_idx in range(2, new_ws.max_row + 1):
    key = new_ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=new_key_col).value
    if key is not None:
        new_rows_by_key[key] = row_idx

# 建立輸出工作表
output_name = "BOM差異"
if output_name in wb.sheetnames:
    del wb[output_name]
out_ws = wb.create_sheet(title=output_name)
out_ws.append(["料號", "變更欄位", "舊值", "新值"])

# 依舊版列序、同列依原表欄位順序比對
old_key_col = old_header["料號"]
compare_fields = [old_ws.cell(row=1, column=col).value
                  for col in range(1, old_ws.max_column + 1)
                  if old_ws.cell(row=1, column=col).value != "料號"]

for old_row in range(2, old_ws.max_row + 1):
    key = old_ws.cell(row=old_row, column=old_key_col).value
    if key is None or key not in new_rows_by_key:
        continue
    new_row = new_rows_by_key[key]
    for field in compare_fields:
        old_val = old_ws.cell(row=old_row, column=old_header[field]).value
        new_val = new_ws.cell(row=new_row, column=new_header[field]).value
        if old_val != new_val:
            out_ws.append([key, field, old_val, new_val])

# 儲存結果
wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
import openpyxl

# 讀取工作簿
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

ws_last = wb["上月名冊"]
ws_this = wb["本月名冊"]

# 建立欄名對照（表頭在第 1 列）
def build_header_map(ws):
    return {cell.value: idx for idx, cell in enumerate(ws[1], start=1)}

header_last = build_header_map(ws_last)
header_this = build_header_map(ws_this)

# 讀取資料列：以員工編號為鍵
def read_rows(ws, header):
    emp_idx = header["員工編號"]
    data = {}
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
        emp_id = row[emp_idx - 1]
        if emp_id:
            data[emp_id] = row
    return data

rows_last = read_rows(ws_last, header_last)
rows_this = read_rows(ws_this, header_this)

# 要比對的欄位（排除員工編號本身）

# 建立結果工作表
result_sheet_name = "變更清單"
if result_sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:
    del wb[result_sheet_name]

for emp_id in rows_this:

    new_row = rows_this[emp_id]

        new_val = new_row[header_this[field] - 1]
        if old_val != new_val:
            ws_result.append([emp_id, field, old_val, new_val])

# 儲存結果
wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
# 推斷：資料表=系統帳、實盤（表頭第1列）｜欄位=料號、品名、數量｜主檔=系統帳｜鍵=料號｜篩選=數量不相等｜輸出=新工作表「數量差異」

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

ws_sys = wb["系統帳"]
ws_act = wb["實盤"]

def build_col_map(ws):
    return {cell.value: cell.column for cell in ws[1] if cell.value}

col_sys = build_col_map(ws_sys)
col_act = build_col_map(ws_act)

def read_data(ws, col_map):
    data = {}
    for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
        pn = ws.cell(row=row, column=col_map["料號"]).value
        if not pn:
            continue
        name = ws.cell(row=row, column=col_map["品名"]).value
        qty = ws.cell(row=row, column=col_map["數量"]).value
        data[pn] = {"品名": name, "數量": qty}
    return data

sys_data = read_data(ws_sys, col_sys)
act_data = read_data(ws_act, col_act)

diff_rows = []
for pn in sorted(set(sys_data) | set(act_data)):

    act_qty = act_data.get(pn, {}).get("數量")
    if sys_qty != act_qty:
        name = sys_data.get(pn, {}).get("品名") or act_data.get(pn, {}).get("品名")
        diff_rows.append([pn, name, sys_qty, act_qty])

for row in diff_rows:
    ws_out.append(row)
```

```python
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font

# 讀取工作簿
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

# 讀取指定工作表，建立「品號」為鍵的資料字典
def read_data(sheet_name):
    ws = wb[sheet_name]
    headers = {cell.value: idx for idx, cell in enumerate(ws[1])}
    data = {}
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
        item_no = row[headers["品號"]]
        if item_no is None or str(item_no).strip() == "":
```

```python
def read_roster(sheet_name):
```

```python
ws_last = wb["上月名冊"]
ws_this = wb["本月名冊"]

def read_roster(ws):
    """依第1列表頭建立對照，回傳 {員工編號: (姓名, 時數)}，只取有員工編號的資料列。"""
    header = {cell.value: idx for idx, cell in enumerate(ws[1])}
    id_idx = header["員工編號"]
    name_idx = header["姓名"]
    hour_idx = header["時數"]

    data = {}
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
        emp_id = row[id_idx]
        if not emp_id:
            continue
        data[emp_id] = (row[name_idx], row[hour_idx])
    return data

        if old_hour != new_hour:
            changes.append((emp_id, name, old_hour, new_hour))

# 若上月有、本月沒有的員工，也視為異動（舊時數存在、新時數空白）

        changes.append((emp_id, name, old_hour, None))

    if emp_id not in last_data:
        changes.append((emp_id, name, None, new_hour))

ws_new = wb.create_sheet("時數異動表")
ws_new.append(["員工編號", "姓名", "舊時數", "新時數"])

for row in changes:
    ws_new.append(row)

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

# 讀取表頭，建立「欄名 -> 欄位索引」對照
def build_header_map(ws):

        cell.value: cell.column
        for cell in ws[1]
        if cell.value is not None
    }

ws_last = wb["上月名冊"]
ws_this = wb["本月名冊"]

header_last = build_header_map(ws_last)
header_this = build_header_map(ws_this)

def read_data(ws, header):
    data = {}
    for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
        emp_id = ws.cell(row=row, column=header["員工編號"]).value
        # 跳過小計列、說明列等沒有員工編號的列
        if not emp_id:
            continue
        name = ws.cell(row=row, column=header["姓名"]).value
        hours = ws.cell(row=row, column=header["時數"]).value
        try:
            hours = int(hours)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            pass
        data[emp_id] = (name, hours)
    return data

this_data = read_data(ws_this, header_this)

# 建立新工作表
```

```python
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

ws_old = wb["上月名冊"]
ws_new = wb["本月名冊"]

def read_hours(ws):
    """以員工編號為鍵，讀取姓名與時數；跳過空編號、小計列與說明列"""
    data = {}
    # 表頭在第1列，資料從第2列開始
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
        emp_id = row[0]
        name = row[1]
        hours = row[2]

        # 排除非資料列：員工編號為空，或姓名為「小計」
        if not emp_id or name == "小計":
            continue

        # 統一轉為字串與數值
        emp_id = str(emp_id).strip()
        try:
            hours = float(hours) if hours is not None else None
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            hours = None

        data[emp_id] = {"name": name, "hours": hours}
    return data

old_data = read_hours(ws_old)

    if old_info["hours"] != new_info["hours"]:

            "員工編號": emp_id,
            "姓名": new_info["name"],
            "舊時數": old_info["hours"],
            "新時數": new_info["hours"],
        })

# 建立新工作表
ws_result = wb.create_sheet(title="時數變動")
headers = ["員工編號", "姓名", "舊時數", "新時數"]

        item["姓名"],
        item["舊時數"],
        item["新時數"],

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
# 推斷：資料表=舊版BOM、新版BOM（表頭第1列）｜欄位=料號、品名、數量｜主檔=料號｜鍵=料號｜篩選=舊數量<>新數量｜輸出=新工作表「數量差異」
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)

# 讀取指定工作表與欄位對照
def read_bom(ws):
    header = {cell.value: idx for idx, cell in enumerate(ws[1], start=1)}
    data = {}
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
        part_no = row[header['料號'] - 1]
        if not part_no:
            break
        name = row[header['品名'] - 1]
        qty = row[header['數量'] - 1]
        data[part_no] = {'品名': name, '數量': qty}
    return data

old_bom = read_bom(wb['舊版BOM'])
new_bom = read_bom(wb['新版BOM'])

# 比較數量差異（以兩張表都有的料號為準）
diff_rows = []
for part_no in old_bom:
    if part_no in new_bom:
        old_qty = old_bom[part_no]['數量']
        new_qty = new_bom[part_no]['數量']
        if old_qty != new_qty:
            diff_rows.append([
                part_no,
                old_bom[part_no]['品名'],
                old_qty,
                new_qty
            ])

# 建立新工作表並寫入結果
ws_out = wb.create_sheet(title='數量差異')
ws_out.append(['料號', '品名', '舊數量', '新數量'])
for row in diff_rows:
    ws_out.append(row)

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```

```python
def build_header_map(ws):

header_act = build_header_map(ws_act)

# 以「料號」為鍵讀取「品名」與「數量」
def read_qty_map(ws, header):

        name = row[col_name - 1]
        qty = row[col_qty - 1]
        if mat:  # 忽略空白料號（如小計列）

    return data
```

```python
        emp_id = ws.cell(row=row, column=col_id).value
        if not emp_id:
            continue
        name = ws.cell(row=row, column=col_name).value
        hours = ws.cell(row=row, column=col_hours).value
        roster[emp_id] = (name, hours)
    return roster
```

```python
prev_headers = [cell.value for cell in ws_prev[1]]
curr_headers = [cell.value for cell in ws_curr[1]]

key_col = "員工編號"
compare_cols = [c for c in prev_headers if c != key_col]

# 以員工編號為鍵建立字典
def build_dict(ws, headers):
    data = {}
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
        if not row or row[0] is None:
            continue
        values = dict(zip(headers, row))
        data[values[key_col]] = values
    return data
```

```python
            diff_rows.append([emp_id, name, old_hours, new_hours])

# 建立新工作表

ws_diff.append(["員工編號", "姓名", "舊時數", "新時數"])
for row in diff_rows:
    ws_diff.append(row)

wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
```
